notes.title: ⚠️ Russian ISP blocked Deadly Quiet in Russia ⚠️
notes.notes: [p]\[EN][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][h3]We’ve been made aware that players in [b]Russia are currently unable to create rooms or host multiplayer sessions[/b] in [i]Deadly Quiet[/i] and other games using the same dedicated servers.[/h3][h3]After a thorough investigation, we’ve determined that [b]this issue is caused by certain Russian ISPs (Internet Service Providers) blocking access to our server infrastructure[/b]. Unfortunately, this is [b]not something we can fix on our side[/b], as it is the result of restrictions imposed at the ISP or national level in Russia.[/h3][p][/p][h2]What Can You Do?[/h2][p]To work around this issue, we recommend the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]Use a VPN[/b]: Connecting through a VPN service that routes your connection outside of Russia [b]will allow you to create and host rooms again[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changing in-game region settings alone will NOT solve the issue[/b] if your ISP is still blocking access. Only a VPN has proven effective in bypassing these restrictions.[/p][/*][/list][p]We understand this is frustrating and we wish there was more we could do. However, until Russian ISPs lift these blocks, a VPN is the most reliable way to restore full multiplayer functionality.[/p][p][i]Our servers use specific IP ranges and ports. If Russian ISPs or authorities are blocking or filtering those IPs or ports (e.g., due to infrastructure-level censorship, or broad firewall rules), you'll get connection issues like timeouts, especially during room creation or matchmaking.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[RU][/b][/p][p]Привет, Выжившие![/p][p]Мы обнаружили, что игроки из России [b]не могут создавать комнаты или запускать многопользовательские сессии[/b] в [i]Deadly Quiet[/i] и других играх, использующих те же выделенные серверы.[/p][p]После тщательного расследования мы пришли к выводу, что проблема вызвана [b]блокировкой доступа к серверной инфраструктуре со стороны некоторых российских интернет-провайдеров (ISP)[/b]. К сожалению, это [b]не находится в нашей зоне контроля[/b], так как ограничения накладываются на уровне провайдера или государства в России.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Что вы можете сделать?[/h3][p]Чтобы обойти эту проблему, мы рекомендуем следующее:[/p][list][*][p][b]Используйте VPN[/b] — подключение через VPN, который направляет ваш трафик за пределы России, позволит вам снова создавать комнаты и играть в мультиплеере.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Изменение региона в настройках игры не решит проблему[/b], если ваш провайдер продолжает блокировать соединение. Только VPN показал эффективность в обходе этих ограничений.[/p][/*][/list][p]Мы понимаем, насколько это неприятно, и нам жаль, что мы не можем напрямую повлиять на ситуацию. До тех пор, пока российские провайдеры не снимут блокировку, [b]VPN остаётся единственным стабильным способом вернуть полную функциональность мультиплеера[/b].[/p][p]Наши серверы используют [b]определённые диапазоны IP-адресов и порты[/b]. Если российские провайдеры или регулирующие органы блокируют или фильтруют эти IP/порты (например, в рамках инфраструктурной цензуры или с помощью широких правил межсетевых экранов), вы будете сталкиваться с такими проблемами, как [b]обрывы соединения и таймауты[/b], особенно при создании комнат или подборе игроков.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Спасибо за ваше терпение и понимание.[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[h2]We’ve just rolled out a new patch with several improvements and fixes. Here’s what’s included:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some items wouldn’t spawn correctly
[*] Improved item placement to make them easier to find
[*] Added visible ping display
[*] Added an action log to notify players of key events (e.g. “Player1 left the game”)
[*] Fixed pause menu bug when spamming the "Esc" key
[*] Fixed the Wendigo sometimes ignoring certain players
[*] Fixed drone going out of bounds
[*] Added Steam Invite support for smoother friend invites
[/list]

[b]New: You can now create private rooms to play with friends only[/b]

⚠️ Important: Make sure to update your client! This version includes changes that are not compatible with older versions.

Thanks for playing and supporting the game! Keep your feedback coming ...we’re listening.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is live!
notes.notes:
[h2]This update brings several quality-of-life improvements and helpful additions based on your feedback:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased item spawn density to improve pacing and exploration.
[*] Additional in-game text to better guide players through key moments.
[*] New setting: Smooth Camera Toggle – choose whether camera movement feels fluid or snappy.
[*] Microphone Sensitivity Option – you can now adjust how much sound affects the Wendigo's behavior.
[*] Voice Chat Troubleshooting Guide – added a quick reference to help resolve common voice chat issues.
[/list]

[h2][b]⚠️ Important Announcement:[/b][/h2]

While we continue working on improvements and collecting your feedback, we wanted to address a common issue with proximity voice chat.

If you're having trouble hearing or being heard, please make sure your input (microphone) and output (speakers/headset) devices are correctly set. Sometimes the game may default to a different device than the one you're using.

To check this:

[list]
[*] Go into the game’s Settings.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Scroll down until you find the Input Device and Output Device options.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Select the correct devices you’re currently using.
[/list]

We're aware that voice chat still has its flaws and are actively working to improve it further. Thanks for your patience and support!

notes.notes:

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[b]Optional Bodycam Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Bodycam view is now optional rather than default. You can enable it in the options menu if you prefer a more immersive experience. This change helps reduce motion sickness for many players.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Microphone Detection
[*] Mic input is now more accurate and responsive for better voice interaction.
[/list]
[h2]Increased Item Outline Range[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items now highlight from a greater distance, making them easier to locate in dark or cluttered areas.
[/list]

[h2]Control Scheme Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] A complete control layout is now available in the options menu for easier reference and customization.
[/list]

[h2]Removals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wendigo Dialogues Removed
[*] We’ve removed all voice lines for the wendigo to maintain a more immersive and atmospheric experience.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Voice Chat
[*] We’re aware of ongoing voice chat issues and are actively working on a fix. Thanks for your patience and continued feedback!
[/list]

notes.title: Deadly Quiet FAQ
notes.notes:
[b]1. Is the game LAN co-op or multiplayer co-op?[/b]
[list]
[*] Deadly Quiet uses multiplayer co-op. You can join public lobbies or invite your friends via Steam or an invite code.
[/list]

[b]2. Will there be item randomization, different maps, or multiple escape routes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! You’ll see random items, varied maps, and multiple escape routes. Not all features may be available at launch, but we plan regular updates. Each map will even have its own specific enemy.
[/list]

[b]3. Does the game require a microphone?[/b]
[list]
[*] A microphone isn’t required, but it really improves the experience. You'll use proximity voice chat to communicate quietly. Just remember: if you’re too loud, the skinwalker might come your way!
[/list]

[b]4. When will the game launch?[/b]
[list]
[*] We’re aiming for Q2 2025. However, the release date might change—we want to make a game we’re proud of, not rush out a cash grab.
[/list]

[b]5. Are you using sourced assets (like from the Unity Asset Store, Sketchfab, or FAB)?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes, some assets are sourced while others are made in-house. We’re two indie developers in college doing our best to work within our budget.
[/list]

[b]6. Will the game feature FSR or DLSS?[/b]
[list]
[*] We plan to support FSR, and DLSS might be added as well. More details will be shared as we get closer to launch.
[/list]

[b]7. Is what’s shown in the trailer the final version of the game?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, the trailer is from an early build. Expect changes and improvements by the time the game is released.
[/list]
